response.sql: WITH order_avgs AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) as avg_fillcount FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), global_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as global_avg_fillcount FROM order_avgs), first_filter AS (SELECT oa.ordersmark, oa.avg_fillcount, (oa.avg_fillcount - ga.global_avg_fillcount) as margin_over_global FROM order_avgs oa CROSS JOIN global_avg ga WHERE oa.avg_fillcount > ga.global_avg_fillcount), group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as group_avg_fillcount FROM first_filter), second_filter AS (SELECT ff.ordersmark, ff.avg_fillcount, ff.margin_over_global, (ff.avg_fillcount - gra.group_avg_fillcount) as margin_over_group FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN group_avg gra WHERE ff.avg_fillcount > gra.group_avg_fillcount) SELECT AVG(avg_fillcount) as avg_per_order_fillcount, AVG(margin_over_global) as avg_margin_over_global, AVG(margin_over_group) as avg_margin_over_group FROM second_filter
